[EN] In order to keep the initiative, I'm sending you out to cull the argons.

Kill kallan reavers, kalash protectors, defenders, and brutes, yusul slashers, and zariik cyanowitches and cyclopses.

Report to Ayva in Kanstria when you've completed the mission.
[ES] Para mantener la iniciativa, te enviaré a eliminar argons.

Derrota a kallan reavers, kalash protectors, defenders y brutes, yusul slashers, y zariik cyanowitches y cyclopses.

Preséntate ante Ayva en Kanstria cuando completes la misión.

[EN] I'm glad we've got soldiers like you, . Well done.
[ES] Me alegra que tengamos soldados como tú, . Bien hecho.

[EN] You haven't achieved your objectives yet. Sorry.
[ES] Aún no has alcanzado tus objetivos. Lo siento.
